name: sapu
description: Marketplace for the sapu plugin (autonomous backlog sweeps with a per-repo contract) and senior-dev-team (a senior software development team as subagents).

plugins.name: sapu
plugins.description: Autonomous issue sweeps driven by a per-repo contract. Install at project scope so each repo opts in explicitly.

plugins.name: senior-dev-team
plugins.description: A senior software development team as subagents: product manager, architect, full-stack developer, database engineer, UI/UX designer, QA analyst and reviewer, technical writer. Installed with sapu; install it at user scope to use it in every project.
